content.short: Storj provides secure, private, decentralized cloud object storage for developers.
content.description: Storj is an S3-compatible platform and suite of decentralized applications that enables you to store data securely and in a decentralized way. Your files are encrypted, broken into pieces, and stored in a global decentralized network of computers; only you can retrieve those files.
content.meta: Storj offers secure, private, decentralized cloud object storage for developers. Discover Storj and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
